title: 第一卷 第16章 让这所谓的诸神，赴死！！
content_zh:
嗡！

    陈昭宁手中的长刀微微颤动，一缕缕灵气弥漫其间，刀光骤然炸裂开来！

    嗤！

    她朝着前方劈出一刀，当场劈死几个拦路的护卫，随后猛地纵马飞跃，冲入了人群之中！

    杀！

    此时陈昭宁施展的，是她家陈家的刀法——山海斩邪刀！

    嗡！

    一道道刀芒在她周身翻飞，左劈右砍间，杀气肆意爆发，人头滚滚落地！

    “阿渊，等着我！”

    陈昭宁大吼出声，骑马在树林里本就施展不开，前后左右还全是劈来的刀光，她竟还是硬生生杀出了一条血路！

    锵！

    陈昭宁左手格挡一刀，弯腰避开另一刀后，右手长刀横扫，当场将两人的头颅扫飞！

    她顺势抱着糯米趴伏在马背上，又斜身朝后方劈出一道璀璨刀芒！

    嗤！

    数个护卫的脖颈上瞬间浮现出殷红的血线，鲜血滋滋飙出！

    陈家刀法本就大开大合，这山海斩邪刀更是兼具搬山之威，海浪汪洋之势！

    可在茂密的树林里根本无法尽兴施展。

    但陈昭宁身躯灵活，纵马狂奔之际，依旧杀得敌人胆战心惊。

    很快，她也杀红了眼，马的四周遍地都是尸体······既有她亲手斩杀的，也有远处陈渊投掷的竹竿所杀！

    饶是陈昭宁出身千年世家，也从未见过如此强横的少年人！

    不愧是开启了三百六十一个灵窍，肉身的强横程度，竟然达到了法体境的水准！

    “怪胎！”

    陈昭宁心头暗自惊呼，眼中难掩对陈渊的震撼。

    死在陈渊手中的人不计其数，其中还有不少人族的护卫和兽人。

    “这就是缚龙搏杀术的真正威力吗？”

    陈昭宁心中暗叹。

    在陈家时，她便对执剑会的这门搏杀术如雷贯耳。

    今日一见，果然名不虚传！

    很快，陈昭宁的四周再无人敢上前。

    众人既怕她手中的长刀，更怕远处时不时投掷过来的尖利竹竿，那简直是夺命的利器！

    太暴力了。

    只剩下七八名浑身是血的护卫，不远不近地跟着。

    他们神色浮现深深的忌惮，既不敢上前，也不敢逃离。

    就这样，陈昭宁渐渐靠近了陈渊的战场。

    可眼前的一幕让她彻底震惊。

    陈渊不知何时拿出了铁刺，正趴在那青色巨蛇的身上，疯狂乱扎！

    噗、噗、噗！

    不知为何，陈渊此刻的力道比先前强横了数倍！

    那青色巨蛇原本坚硬无比的鳞片，竟被扎得全身都是孔洞，如同蜂巢一般，汩汩冒着鲜血！

    “嘶啊！！！”

    青色巨蛇发出凄厉的嘶鸣，身形以肉眼可见的速度褪去了蛇形，化回了人形。

    陈渊一把搂住她的脖颈，将铁刺顶在她的下巴上，朝着前方的树林厉声大吼：

    “站住！”

    “他妈的，都给老子站住！！”

    陈昭宁心头一震！

    她这才发现，树林的另一侧，竟然又出现了一群身着衙役服饰的人。
content_en:
Buzz!

The long sword in Chen Zhaoning's hand trembled slightly, wisps of spiritual energy filled it, and the sword suddenly exploded with light!

laugh!

She slashed forward with a knife, killing several guards blocking the way on the spot, then suddenly leaped on her horse and rushed into the crowd!

kill!

At this time, what Chen Zhaoning was using was the sword technique of her Chen family - the Mountain and Sea Evil Killing Sword!

Buzz!

A series of sword lights flew around her body, slashing left and right, murderous intent exploded wantonly, and heads rolled to the ground!

"Ayuan, wait for me!"

Chen Zhaoning roared loudly. She couldn't do anything while riding a horse in the woods. There were still swords coming from behind, left and right, but she still managed to fight her way out!

Clang!

Chen Zhaoning blocked one knife with his left hand, bent down to avoid another knife, and then swept the long knife with his right hand, sweeping away the two heads on the spot!

She took advantage of the situation and lay down on the horse with Nuomi in her arms, then leaned over and slashed backwards with a bright sword light!

laugh!

Bright red blood lines instantly appeared on the necks of several guards, and blood spurted out!

The Chen family's sword skills are already great, and this Mountain and Sea Evil Killing Sword has the power to move mountains and ocean waves!

But it is impossible to fully display it in the dense woods.

However, Chen Zhaoning's body was flexible and he could still kill his enemies with fear while galloping on horseback.

Soon, she became red-blooded, and there were corpses all around the horse... including those killed by her own hands, and those killed by bamboo poles thrown by Chen Yuan from a distance!

Even though Chen Zhaoning comes from a thousand-year-old family, he has never seen such a tyrannical young man!

It is worthy of saying that he has opened 361 spiritual apertures, and his physical body's tyranny has actually reached the level of the Dharma Body Realm!

"Freak!"

Chen Zhaoning secretly exclaimed, his eyes unable to conceal the shock towards Chen Yuan.

Countless people died in Chen Yuan's hands, including many human guards and orcs.

"Is this the true power of the dragon-binding fighting technique?"

Chen Zhaoning sighed inwardly.

When she was in the Chen family, she was very familiar with the fighting technique of the Sword Club.

When I saw it today, it certainly lived up to its reputation!

Soon, no one around Chen Zhaoning dared to step forward.

Everyone was afraid of the long knife in her hand, and even more afraid of the sharp bamboo poles thrown from a distance from time to time. They were simply deadly weapons!

Too violent.

Only seven or eight guards, covered in blood, were left, following closely.

Their expressions showed deep fear, and they neither dared to step forward nor escape.

In this way, Chen Zhaoning gradually approached Chen Yuan's battlefield.

But the scene in front of her completely shocked her.

Chen Yuan didn't know when he took out the iron thorn, and he was lying on the body of the giant green snake, stabbing wildly!

Poof, poof, poof!

For some reason, Chen Yuan's strength at this moment was several times stronger than before!

The originally extremely hard scales of the giant green snake were actually pricked with holes all over its body, like a honeycomb, with blood gushing out!

"Hiss!!!"

The giant green snake let out a shrill scream, and its body shape lost its snake shape at a speed visible to the naked eye and returned to its human form.

Chen Yuan grabbed her neck, put the iron thorn on her chin, and shouted sharply towards the woods ahead:

"Stop!"

"Fuck you, stop here!!"

Chen Zhaoning was shocked!

Only then did she realize that on the other side of the woods, another group of people wearing government uniforms appeared.
